title: Read surface: findings in the summary, an MCP tool and the dashboard

story.i_want_to: see every finding with its state, issue and attempts
story.so_that: I can tell what the loop is doing without reading GitHub

rationale: CLAUDE.md: an operator-facing endpoint is not done until an MCP tool calls it.

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /api/v1/chg_findings (role :agent, tenant from the key) lists findings filtered by state, kind and repo, newest first, capped; each row carries kind, fingerprint, repo, state, occurrences, fix_attempts, loop_depth, the issue URL and timestamps.
MCP tool chg_findings calls it, declared, dispatched, documented in mcp-server/README.md, with a wiring test; mcp-server version bumped.
Dashboard.summary/2 gains a findings panel (counts per state and kind, the escalated list), shown on /chg and returned by chg_ledger_summary.
POST /api/v1/chg_findings/:id/clear (role :user, human-anchored) clears an escalated finding back to queued; an MCP tool calls it.

test_cases.name: list and isolation
preconditions: findings in tenants A and B

test_cases.name: clear needs a user key
steps: POST clear with an agent key

technical_notes: A clear resets fix_attempts, and an action's generation is the fix-attempt count, so the next open after a clear would repeat an (action, generation) already used and ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING would drop it silently. chg_findings.cycle counts the clears and is part of the once-per-act key (finding_id, cycle, action, generation), so each cycle acts afresh.
ChgFindingController is claimed by TierCapabilities' issue_intake surface: clearing re-files an issue through the tenant's intake source, the same surface as enrolling it.
